questions_and_answers.question_text: Write a Chinese sentence using the pattern 'Nèitian wǒmen yǒu shì, ___.' with the cue 'no way of going'.

answers.answer_text: Nèitian wǒmen yǒu shì, méi bànfǎ qù.

answers.answer_text: Nèitian wǒmen yǒu shì, bù néng yìqǐ qù.

answers.answer_text: Nèitian wǒmen yǒu shì, bù néng dōu qù.

answers.answer_text: Nèitian wǒmen yǒu shì, dōu bù néng qù.
